dedupe_keys.name: evacuation of the city of rouen gama agent based traffic model of a city evacuation using the advanced driving skill

description: This model shows the evacuation of the city of Rouen in France by road, as a worked example of the advanced driving skill of the GAMA agent-based modelling platform. It was published in the CoMSES library in 2019 by Guillaume Czura, Patrick Taillandier, Pierrick Tranouez and Eric Daudé. Drivers are agents moving on the road network with the platform's detailed driving behaviour, so the model can show congestion building up as people leave. Version 1.0.0 is available as a free download from CoMSES under the GPL-3.0 licence and runs in the free GAMA platform. Caveats: the library page gives only a one-line description, the hazard behind the evacuation is not described there, and the model is presented as an illustration, not a validated plan. Coverage is the city of Rouen. Simulation uses: a starting point for road evacuation studies of cities, and for linking emergency plans with traffic models. Related records: the SiFlo flood evacuation model (model-comses-siflo-flood-inhabitant-behaviour), also built in GAMA, adds flooding and household decisions.
name: Evacuation of the city of Rouen: GAMA agent-based traffic model of a city evacuation using the advanced driving skill
outputs: Traffic flow and evacuation progress on the road network
